attribution: Pair-programmed by SE Community + Cortex Code
_comment: Retirement routes for projects that once had a public URL. Record routes BEFORE moving files so old links land on a tombstone page instead of a 404. Schema per project: date (YYYY-MM-DD) and routes (array of absolute paths, each must start with /<project>/). 'reason' and 'successor' are documentation for maintainers; build.mjs ignores them.

guide-openflow-shopify-multistore.reason: Merged with guide-shopify-bulk-api-coco. Both defined the same DAILY_SHOP_ACTIVITY metric and had already drifted apart.

guide-shopify-bulk-api-coco.reason: Merged with guide-openflow-shopify-multistore. The Bulk API path is now path-native-coco.md in the successor.

guide-cortex-agent-image-tool.reason: Taught the type:"generic" custom-tool pattern a second time. Folded in as a chapter of the orchestration guide.

guide-cortex-code-access-control.reason: Renamed. Scope widened from Cortex Code to the whole Cortex surface after absorbing the AI-function RBAC material from guide-snowflake-cost-visibility.
